from pyspark.sql.functions import col, avg, round, count
df = spark.read.format("delta").load("abfss://silver@myetlpipeline.dfs.core.windows.net/energy_mix_cleaned/")

# 3. Create Gold Aggregations (Regional Energy Transition KPI Summary)
df_gold_regional = df.groupBy("region", "year").agg(
    round(avg("coal_pct"), 2).alias("avg_coal_pct"),
    round(avg("oil_pct"), 2).alias("avg_oil_pct"),
    round(avg("gas_pct"), 2).alias("avg_gas_pct"),
    round(avg("fossil_pct"), 2).alias("avg_fossil_pct"),
    round(avg("clean_pct"), 2).alias("avg_clean_pct"),
    round(avg("solar_pct"), 2).alias("avg_solar_pct"),
    count("country").alias("total_countries")
)

# 4. Create Gold Aggregations (Country Multi-Year Delta Summary)
df_gold_country = df.groupBy("country", "iso3", "region", "year").agg(
    round(avg("fossil_pct"), 2).alias("fossil_pct"),
    round(avg("clean_pct"), 2).alias("clean_pct"),
    round(avg("solar_pct"), 2).alias("solar_pct"),
    round(avg("hydro_pct"), 2).alias("hydro_pct"),
    round(avg("nuclear_pct"), 2).alias("nuclear_pct")
)

# 5. Write Gold datasets as Delta tables into the Gold ADLS Container
gold_regional_path = "abfss://gold@myetlpipeline.dfs.core.windows.net/energy_mix_gold_regional/"
gold_country_path = "abfss://gold@myetlpipeline.dfs.core.windows.net/energy_mix_gold_country/"

df_gold_regional.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true").save(gold_regional_path)
df_gold_country.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true").save(gold_country_path)

print("Gold Delta tables created successfully!")
